summary: Full e2e testing of Mother's Day card-sharing app. All 6 backend pytest tests passed (root, cloudinary signature with valid+invalid folder, card create, card get, 404, AI suggest). Frontend e2e flow passed: landing -> create -> fill names/message -> AI suggest (3 suggestions returned and applied) -> stickers tab (add Heart, controls visible) -> style tab (bg color & font) -> frame tab -> music tab -> save -> /card/:slug loads with confetti & music toggle visible. Invalid slug shows 'Card not found' page.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py line 198: @app.on_event('shutdown') is deprecated in FastAPI; consider lifespan handlers
ai_suggest_message returns variable count (2-3) due to LLM split fallback; UI handles gracefully but spec says 'EXACTLY 3' — minor robustness concern
Cloudinary signature endpoint allows folder param without auth/rate-limiting — could be abused (low risk for anonymous app, but worth noting)
create_card has 8-attempt slug retry but no test for collision branch — low risk with 8-char alphanumeric
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_ prefixed card via API during pytest (sender_name=TEST_Maya, recipient_name=TEST_Mom). Also created one card via UI (sender=Maya, recipient=Anjali). Not cleaned up; safe due to random slugs.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file at /app/backend/tests/test_backend_api.py covers all 5 endpoints. AI test takes ~3-5s. UI flow uses data-testid attributes thoroughly. Skipped Cloudinary actual upload (requires file dialog) per agent note - signature endpoint verified working.
rca of the issue: No issues found - all flows working as designed.
